changelog: Buttons and labels now always fit on ONE line - the Recent writing title no longer breaks into two lines, and the Export / Backup / Restore / Newest buttons no longer overflow off the screen.

Live Translate is more accurate: it now works out what you meant in the language you spoke, then translates fully into the set language - names are written by sound exactly as you say them (e.g. Saminul stays Saminul), and nothing is left behind in the wrong script.
